roi.selection: source order in SOURCE_INDEX, one global PCG64 seed1729. First seed drawn by lumped triangle area on eligible vertices. Nearest384 via eligible induced edge-length Dijkstra, (distance, sourceID) ordering. ROI1 seed maximizes distance to ROI0, disconnected eligible vertex lowestID has priority. Remove ROI0 from graph and candidate set. Shortfall retained, no extra seeds.
roi.eligible: finite coordinates, all incident triangles crossnorm>64eps*bboxdiag^2, finite nonzero area-weighted geometric normal
roi.shortfall: save actual count, ROI unusable unless exactly384
roi.overlaps: second ROI always excludes first, disconnected coverage prioritized

centers.boundary: F vertices adjacent to outside F plus source boundary/nonmanifold edge endpoints in F
centers.interior: full source edge-geodesic D to boundary, finite D>64eps*bboxdiag and D>=0.5maxD
centers.selection: first maxD then geodesic farthest-point among remaining candidates, ties lower sourceID, stop if none or separation<=length tolerance, no filling

validity.pair: same source/topology/sourcepoint mapping, current geometry reconstructed exactly, outside true changed domain bitwise identical, labels from actual coordinate delta
validity.geometry: finite, no new crossnorm<=64eps*bboxdiag^2, no original nondegenerate face with cross_new dot cross_old<=0, support>=6 and wholly inside F
validity.direction: all affected incident faces inside confirmed consistent patch or reliable closed component, remaining unknown excluded from dent training
validity.usable_roi: exact384 points and at least2 distinct centers each with>=1 numerically valid and direction-confirmed combination. All otherwise valid combos of that ROI are sampling members, failures remain indexed
validity.scope: local reversal is cross dot original, global self-intersection unverified

sampling.state: emit normal and damaged row for each pair event, randint(2) swaps within pair, no additional shuffle, exact512/512 each step
sampling.expected: normal physical observation probability=P(ROI)/2, each dent=P(ROI)/(2*usable_combo_count). Positive-label fraction recorded independently, normalization and pos_weight deferred

audit.natural_concavity: mean neighbor offset dot outward normal, signed threshold64eps*bboxdiag, report concave/convex/flat incidence and per-point damage frequency. Synthetic normal labels remain zero
audit.encoder_radius: 0.05*undamaged posture bboxdiag, record r/R and a/R plus true damaged fraction among Euclidean vertices within R of center, no model forwards
audit.representative: first ROI/first center/.55 radius/.30 depth in every selected posture, retained whether valid or failing, normal/damaged local geometry and arrows

input_contract: return only full current vertices, source topology, F mapping and source IDs. Source baseline used internally for compact reconstruction, reference/delta/mask files belong to separate supervision domain
continuation: fixed result commit, one callback then end awaiting independent review
